purpose: Ready frameset to replay the app's realm/login-server (TCP 148.222.93.33:6670) flow from any origin (esp. from the device via frida socket). If this realm login is accepted, its S>C 0x4013 reply carries the assigned gateway IP; then the gateway 0x1001/0x2001 flow can be replayed there and should be accepted.
captured_from: captures/gw2.pcap (live app session 2026-10-22 13:29 ICT, successful gateway auth)
steps: 1) TCP connect realm server, send raw1001 (below).
2) read S>C 0x1002; session key = header-extension bytes [2:18] (16 ASCII chars).
3) for each send item: body = 16 random IV + AES-128-CBC(key, IV, plaintext); header = captured header with body_len patched at offset 19..20 big-endian to len(body); send header+body.
4) read S>C: 0x2002 + 0x6002 = realm auth OK; decrypt S>C 0x4013 bodies with same key; the reply whose plaintext contains an ASCII dotted IP is the ASSIGNED GATEWAY.
5) connect assigned gateway IP:6630, send raw1001 then 0x2001 with token_38 -> expect 0x2002 AUTH OK.
